SolutionDocumentation.Description: A comprehensive set of building blocks for .NET applications providing infrastructure, domain, application, and cross-cutting concerns.

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Domain
Project.Description: Core domain layer containing entities, value objects, domain events, business rules, and aggregates. This is the heart of the domain-driven design architecture.

KeyComponents.Component: Entities - Base entity classes and auditable entities
ValueObjects - Immutable value objects for domain modeling
Events - Domain events for event-driven architecture

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Results
Project.Description: Provides result types for handling operation outcomes, errors, and success responses in a type-safe manner.

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Specification
Project.Description: Implements the Specification pattern for encapsulating query logic and business rules in a reusable manner.

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Pagination
Project.Description: Provides pagination support for querying large datasets efficiently.

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Application
Project.Description: Application layer containing CQRS patterns, commands, queries, behaviors, events, and context management for application services.

KeyComponents.Component: CQRS - Command and Query Responsibility Segregation patterns
Behaviors - Pipeline behaviors for cross-cutting concerns

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Validation
Project.Description: Validation layer using FluentValidation for request and command validation with dependency injection support.

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Persistence
Project.Description: Persistence layer providing Entity Framework Core integration, repositories, specifications, and database context management.

KeyComponents.Component: Repositories - Generic and specialized repository implementations
Interceptors - EF Core interceptors for auditing and more
Abstractions - Repository and unit of work abstractions

Project.Name: BuildingBlocks.Infrastructure
Project.Description: Infrastructure layer providing implementations for cross-cutting concerns including event handling, date/time services, and identifiers.

KeyComponents.Component: Events - Event handling and publishing infrastructure
DateTime - Date and time service implementations

Layer.Name: Domain Layer
Layer.Responsibility: Contains business logic, entities, and domain rules. No external dependencies.

Layer.Name: Application Layer
Layer.Responsibility: Orchestrates business logic, implements CQRS patterns, and defines application services.

Layer.Name: Infrastructure Layer
Layer.Responsibility: Provides technical implementations for data access, external services, and cross-cutting concerns.
